run_gtn_loss_example: run the pytorch GTN loss example to compute sequence criterion loss and gradients
build_gtn_loss_function: build a custom PyTorch loss function using GTN graphs for frame-level to token-level alignment
create_target_graph: create a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple input frames
compute_forward_loss: compute the forward loss by scoring target graphs against emissions and normalizing with forward score
compute_backward_gradients: compute backward gradients for GTN loss using parallel batch processing and emissions graph gradients
